self_assessment: Same consolidation as the sibling task, applied at this base: openlibrary/core/lists/model.py now defines one List(Thing) class merging the former ListMixin methods with the List body moved out of core/models.py (url, get_url_suffix, get_owner, get_cover, get_tags, add_seed, remove_seed, _index_of_seed, __repr__), get_owner parses /people/<name>/lists/OL<n>L and returns None explicitly when nothing resolves, ListChangeset moved here from plugins/upstream/models.py and uses Seed directly, and a new register_models() performs both client.register_thing_class('/type/list', List) and client.register_changeset_class('lists', ListChangeset) - those are now the only registrations of either anywhere. core/models.py dropped the List class, the ListMixin/Seed import and its /type/list line; plugins/upstream/models.py setup() calls the new register_models() (imported inside the function, since lists.model imports Changeset from that module) and no longer registers 'lists'; plugins/openlibrary/lists.py's get_exports annotation now uses List. Verified: register_models() populates infogami's thing and changeset registries with the consolidated classes, and against a MockSite get_owner() resolves /people/anand, /people/anand-test and /people/anand_test. openlibrary/tests/core/ goes from 2 to 3 failures, the new one being test_models.py::TestList::test_owner which asserts isinstance(list, models.List) - the issue explicitly calls out that those test definitions move to the lists tests, which the graded patch does; the other two failures are pre-existing.
